title: First GTA6 Actor Confirmed: Stephen Root Confirms Involvement
description: As GTA6 approaches, the first actor has confirmed their involvement in the project following an interview with the Associated Press.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The First GTA 6 Actor Has Confirmed Their Involvement, and Nobody's Surprised

As Grand Theft Auto 6 draws ever closer to its anticipated release, the gaming community is constantly on the lookout for new details about Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster. Recently, according to a report by gaming outlet Push Square, some actors are starting to let slip their direct involvement with the massive project.

### Stephen Root Confirms His Role

Namely, actor Stephen Root has officially confirmed his role in the game during an interview with the Associated Press. As the actor himself reportedly notes, however, this confirmation comes as very little surprise to dedicated fans who recognized his distinct voice or anticipated his casting.

The familiarity of his voice has long been a staple in various forms of media, and his presence in the upcoming title adds another layer of excitement for players eagerly waiting to explore the next chapter of the franchise.

### Anticipation Continues to Build

As one of the biggest games on the horizon, every small detail regarding GTA 6 garners massive attention from the global gaming community. While Rockstar Games has kept a tight lid on overall project specifics, interviews and casual reveals from cast members like Stephen Root provide the first concrete glimpses behind the scenes as the release window approaches.

Fans and industry watchers will undoubtedly be keeping a close eye on further interviews and announcements as the marketing cycle for GTA 6 ramps up in the coming months.

## Editor's Take

Stephen Root confirming his involvement in GTA 6 via the Associated Press is a fun milestone as we approach the game's launch. While it may not shock fans who spotted the signs early, it officially kicks off the season of actor reveals and behind-the-scenes glimpses for Rockstar's latest masterpiece.
